newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 17.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 17.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The state privatisation agency APV said it would transfer 300 billion forints to the state budget in 1996 and 50 billion in 1997.
- IPOSZ, an organisation of industrial entrepreneurs, said it was ready to organize protests against the amendments on the social security law once they take effect.
- The management of the autobus-maker Ikarus confirmed that the company planned to employ 500 more workers in 1997 and to post a profit of four billion forints.
- The government proposed stricter constructions regulations.
- Socialist Party representatives in the Assembly of Budapest accepted the candidate for the post of the capital's police chief.
